title: fumaria capreolata var. muralis
intro: Fumaria capreolata var. muralis, commonly known as Rock Cress or Fumitory, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. The plant has been used to treat a variety of health issues, including digestive problems, arthritis, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Fumaria capreolata var. muralis include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to alleviate pain and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic uses.
